title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.value: Nonuniform spacing in this short sample, with both longer and shorter intervals across the strip.
fields.basis: Provisional positive peak-to-peak spacing in original PDF 584
fields.reason: Selected pixel gaps: 106 px, 89 px, 87.5 px, 81 px, 69.5 px, 81 px, 93 px, 66 px. These describe a short sample, not a validated rhythm classification.

fields.basis: Assumed course speed 25 mm/s; 151 detected lines enclose 150 minor horizontal intervals across 736 pixels in the observed calibration segment.
fields.reason: 8 retained positive peak-to-peak intervals have mean spacing 84.12 px, giving 87.5 bpm. Individual-interval estimates span approximately 69.4–111.5 bpm under the same assumption; this is observed interval variation, not a confidence interval. No numerical speed label or labeled timing duration is verified on this strip. This is interval-derived, not a six-second beat count or a claim of a stable rate.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Low-amplitude pre-complex notches and rounded changes are visible, but shape and number vary. The selected regions include almost flat, slightly raised and double-bump contours; no uniform discrete P morphology is resolved. Small bumps are documented without assigning one to each ventricular complex. The fourth selected region alone contains two distinguishable low crests.

fields.value: Nine sharp positive spikes with immediate negative returns. Small rounded later humps and shallow negative deflections appear between spikes on an uneven low-amplitude trace.
fields.basis: New descriptive observation of the original raster, not a source-authored rhythm diagnosis
fields.reason: No diagnostic rhythm label, validated P-wave identity, validated conduction interval or clinical conclusion is assigned. Conditional interval estimates, where present, remain unvalidated. Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.

Pixel-picking and grid-sensitivity allowances are illustrative, not confidence intervals. Unknown paper speed, missed events, waveform identity and phase comparability are not bounded by those allowances.
A mean can conceal changing spacing. No sustained rate or diagnostic rhythm is inferred.

Two nonoverlapping, wave-free upper bands provide matching complete line sequences within 0.5 px. Their adjacent gaps are consistent with the visually evident ~5 px minor grid. Lower-band detections miss lines and are not used.
Small between-spike bumps and broad later humps are not counted as additional ventricular complexes.
The final positive spike and downward return remain visible near the right edge and are retained.
